== Hey Kylara ==
=== Bot flag ===

Hello Kylara, would you mind flagging [[User:Moonwatcher x Qibli +bot+]] as a bot? I only ask you as [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin 2000]] hasn't returned [[User talk:Moridin 2000#Hello Chris - Bot edits + bot tag + Adding Category:Redirects to all redirects|my message]], and we don't have much of an active community. I don't need the tag to perform fully automated edits as the bot already can, but just to screen them from [[Special:RecentChanges]] so I can more easily track other users' edits to revert vandalism.<br>
For context on why I'm bot editing: Mainly right now it's due to the thousands of instances of <code><span style="background-color: #3d3d3d"><nowiki>\{\{DISPLAYTITLE\|''([^']*)''<br /><br /><small>([^<]*)<\/small>\}\}</nowiki></span></code> (regex), which is horrible formatting, and doesn't even work (it's <code><span style="background-color: #3d3d3d"><nowiki>{{DISPLAYTITLE:</nowiki></span></code> not <code><span style="background-color: #3d3d3d"><nowiki>{{DISPLAYTITLE|</nowiki></span></code>, <code><span style="background-color: #3d3d3d"><nowiki><br></nowiki></span></code> doesn't work in these and just displays <code><span style="background-color: #3d3d3d"><nowiki><br></nowiki></span></code>, etc.), as well as just performing [[w:wikipedia:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser/General fixes|General Fixes]] on main mainspace articles.

=== Content Moderation ===
As a final question I’d like to ask if you’d be willing to give myself and the bot content moderator rights? I would go through the appropriate channels for adoption, but unfortunately I was promoted on Stephen King Wiki and Coding Help Wiki recently so I’m ineligible.
